# GetSitGo | Spark Info-Tech Enterprise

SPARK Info-Tech Enterprise helps businesses start, simplify, and grow through technology that feels human.
At SPARK, we're more than an IT provider—we're a technology partner that helps businesses improve operations and confidently embrace digital transformation. Whether you're starting a new business or scaling an existing one, we solve real problems and grow alongside our clients. SPARK can be contacted through its website at https://getsitgo.com.
